summary: Implementation plan for the Focused Studio Architecture Fix covering: (1) Right Inspector auto-sync & fallback resolution for DO, MRN, DN, PV, REC, and Totals blocks; (2) strict single-selection and splitting Receipt (REC), Payment Voucher (PV), and Totals into independent modular Lego blocks; (3) direct whole-card & sub-element Text & Style Bar formatting with full CSS inheritance; and (4) stripping DO- and sequence suffixes from canonical references when switching to PO/PV.
